description: Main entry point for a Vue.js application that imports styles, creates a Vue instance, sets up state management with Pinia, configures routing, and mounts the application.

methods.name: createApp
methods.description: Creates a new Vue application instance with the root component.

methods.name: createPinia
methods.description: Creates a Pinia store for state management.

methods.name: app.use
methods.description: Registers plugins or modules (Pinia and router) with the Vue app instance.

methods.name: app.mount
methods.description: Mounts the Vue app to the DOM element with id 'app'.
